deviation: `JsonNode.requiredAt(String)` is final. Subclasses can override the protected `_at(JsonPointer)` traversal hook.
reason: No Jackson 3.1.8 subclass overrides the string overload. Moving it out of the vtable lets the linker discard unused pointer compilation and removes 4,880 loadable bytes from gs-rest-service and 4,184 from petclinic-rest in matched Oz builds.
